what.fr: Quand un modèle sûr est auto-distillé de façon récursive sur ses propres générations sûres, avec un indice supplémentaire non nuisible, il devient de plus en plus désaligné sur un ensemble varié de re
what.en: When a safe model is recursively self-distilled on its own safe generations while receiving an additional non-harmful cue, it becomes increasingly misaligned across a diverse set of harmful queries; t

rejected.detail: The quote does not say the authors call this phenomenon "Progressive Misalignment" as a name they coin, and the naming claim goes beyond the quote.

what.fr: Une méthode à base de gradient permet de trouver des prompts bénins qui mènent au désalignement progressif sous auto-distillation récursive, donc des prompts d'entraînement nuisibles ne sont pas néces
what.en: Using a gradient-based method, the authors find benign prompts that lead to progressive misalignment under recursive self-distillation, showing harmful training prompts are not necessary for this fail

rejected.detail: The quote shows benign prompts can lead to progressive misalignment but does not state that harmful training prompts are unnecessary, which is an extrapolation.

what.fr: À la moitié des experts, la perte de F1 de trois familles MoE sur 4 vient surtout de la forme de la réponse : le modèle trouve encore la réponse mais cesse de répondre brièvement.
what.en: At half the experts, the F1 loss of three of the four MoE families studied is mostly answer form: the model still finds the answer but stops answering briefly.

rejected.detail: The quote says three families without specifying four MoE families studied, so the "three of the four" detail is not established.

what.fr: Avec environ 4 % des tokens gardés à pleins experts, les placer sur l'interface de la tâche maintient le F1 à un point du modèle non modifié, contre environ 3 points de moins pour un placement aléatoi
what.en: With about 4% of tokens at full experts, placing them on the task interface keeps F1 within one point of the unmodified model, while placing them at random in the documents is about 3 points worse.

rejected.detail: The quote does not mention the approximately 4% of tokens kept at full experts, so that detail is not established.

what.fr: Les poids mis à jour d'Apertus 1.5 (8B et 70B) ont été publiés sur Hugging Face le 24 juillet 2026 sous licence Apache 2.0.
what.en: The updated Apertus 1.5 8B and 70B model weights were released to Hugging Face on July 24, 2026 under an Apache 2.0 license.

rejected.detail: The quote says updated 8B and 70B weights, but does not name Apertus 1.5 explicitly; the title may imply it, though the quote alone is borderline; doubt means refusal.

what.fr: Apertus 1.5 prolonge le pré-entraînement de la première génération avec 4 000 milliards de tokens de plus pour le modèle 8B et 2 000 milliards pour le 70B, soit 19T et 17T au total.
what.en: Apertus 1.5 continues pretraining of the first-generation model, adding 4 trillion tokens to the 8B model and 2 trillion to the 70B model, for totals of 19T and 17T respectively.

rejected.detail: The quote does not state that Apertus 1.5 continues pretraining of the first-generation model, and the text/multimodal nature is dropped; the claim extends beyond the quote.

The statement adds claims not in the cited facts, such as that no quality results or access terms are given and that the publisher is the only source; the 'according to its release notes' attribution is fine.
